name: Widgeteer – AI Form Builder
author: nofusshere

sections.description:
Widgeteer is your agent marketeer and engineer. It doesn’t just create crisp marketing material such as FAQs and before-and-after sliders, it also builds fully working forms. Receive an instant email on every submission, or pass submissions on to Zapier, n8n and more. Countdown timer? Product feedback form? Product recommendation quiz? It does all that and more.

  • Create working forms, FAQ sections or “whatever” using AI.
  • All done for you: no setup, no keys needed. Join and generate.
  • No tech, no config, no code. This is our job, not yours.
  • Made in, and supported from, Britain 🇬🇧

What you can build

  • Contact, callback and appointment request forms
  • Newsletter and waiting-list sign-ups
  • Product feedback forms and recommendation quizzes
  • FAQ sections, countdown timers and before-and-after sliders
  • Restaurant menus, price lists and other content cards
  • Surveys, ratings and multi-step questionnaires

How it works

  1. Install and activate the plugin, then open Widgeteer in your dashboard menu.
  2. Enter your email address. We send you a one-time code, so there is no password to remember.
  3. Describe the widget you want, or pick an idea from the prompt library, and press Generate.
  4. Want a change? Tell Widgeteer what to change, such as “add a phone number field”, and it updates the widget for you.
  5. Add it to any page with the Widgeteer AI Widget block, or paste its shortcode.
  6. Choose what happens when someone submits: an email to you, or a hand-off to Zapier, n8n and other tools.

Features

  • Edit any word, field, order or colour scheme yourself.
  • Live preview of every widget.
  • Multi-step forms, required fields, validation and a thank-you message.
  • Auto-fields and hidden fields.
  • Run several actions on one widget.
  • Submissions log showing whether each one was delivered, per action.
  • Works on single sites and on multisite networks.

Actions and integrations

  • Email notifications
  • Zapier
  • Make.com
  • n8n
  • Microsoft Power Automate
  • IFTTT
  • Airtable
  • Telegram
  • Formspark
  • Webhooks, for any other tool
  • And many more, with new ones added all the time

External services

The plugin needs the hosted Widgeteer service to work.

  • https://app.widgeteer.ai: your email and sign-in code when you sign in, your widget descriptions and edit requests, the form fields visitors submit (so they can be delivered), and requests for your widgets, actions, activity and plan when you open those screens.
  • https://cdn.widgeteer.ai: widgets and their script and styles, loaded by the browser wherever a widget is shown. It sees the IP address, browser and page address.
  • https://cdn.jolstream.nofuss.site: pictures of ready widgets on the “Create widget” screen. It sees your IP address and browser.
  • “See plans” opens https://app.widgeteer.ai/billing/ in a new tab with your email filled in. Payment there is handled by Stripe (terms, privacy). The plugin never takes payment.

Widgeteer terms of service and privacy policy.
sections.faq:
Do I need an account?

Yes. You create one inside the plugin with just your email address, and we email you a one-time code to sign in.

Is it free?

The plugin is free and nothing inside it is locked. Widgeteer itself is a hosted service with a free plan and a paid plan, and what you can do each month depends on your plan. Plan limits are applied by the service, not by the plugin; when you reach one, the plugin shows a link to see the plans.

Where do I manage my plan?

At app.widgeteer.ai, signed in with the same email address.

How do I add a widget to a page?

In the block editor, add the Widgeteer AI Widget block and pick your widget. Anywhere else, paste the shortcode shown on the widget’s page, for example [widgeteer_widget id="123"].

Where do form submissions go?

To your Widgeteer account, which emails you or passes them on to the tools you connected. You can review them under Widgeteer → Submissions. They are not stored in your WordPress database.

What happens if I delete the plugin?

Its settings and data are removed from your site. Your Widgeteer account and your widgets are kept, so you can reinstall and sign in again at any time.
